lines.text: Work order's in my jacket. Five rooms, one clean minute each.
Levels, before anything. Headphones on, hear the room — then roll, and hold still.
Right. Before I go anywhere — write down where I am going.
Inner door, south end. Down to B3 — follow the bearing. That mark is the whole point of making it.
Down the west stair, behind the dock. Mark them off as you go and you never lose an hour.
Quietly, then. Everything I do in here, the building keeps.
That's me on the take. {ctx.spoilReason === 'you moved' ? 'Feet.' : 'Hand on the light.'} Again.
Levels good. Floor is somewhere under sixty. This building is dead.
